groups.name: bounded_state_operation_roster_map_caller
groups.base_provenance: 12A98D0 obtains roster R10 from global3326468, resolves a peer-associated entity ID through roster+D0/D8/DC/E0 map to ordinal, reads ordinal*20+3B4, and calls ACF420 with that index and outer3326340+1FA08. The outer+1FA08 parent constructor call is pinned above.

groups.name: bounded_state_operation_false_at_four
groups.base_provenance: ACF420 maps parent to S=P+50. Index>=4 returns AL=0 before accessing slot storage; valid index computes slot S+80+n*90, updates vector/state fields and invokes downstream functions. The caller proceeds without testing AL, so this is operation denial, not proof of join rejection.

groups.name: roster_map_to_32bit_mask_consumer
groups.base_provenance: 1277920 looks up entity ID through the same roster map, obtains ordinal, reads record+3B4 network index, then tests that bit in dword masks from another system global33269C0. It excludes FFFFFFFF but has no four bound. Bits4..7 fit this consumer width; producer behavior remains unknown.

groups.name: roster_map_direct_index_getter
groups.base_provenance: 606AD0 explicitly loads global3326468 and its map, obtains ordinal, returns dword[roster+ordinal*20+3B4]. Missing map result returns FFFFFFFF; no four-index clamp appears in this getter.

groups.name: additional_unbounded_array_writer_capacity_not_proven
groups.base_provenance: 7275D6 reads the index from global3326468 roster loop and passes it as EDX to14335F0; the callee writes two float fields to destination+index*298+80E24 before any range test. Destination is caller RSI+4C8260. Its capacity and UI semantics are not proven, so this is retained as one concrete unresolved array consumer, not a confirmed four-slot collision.
